testcase.name: a focus on the action joins Fermer when the programme ends
a programme is current from its start inclusive to its end exclusive
arrival focuses the action only for a current programme, on the injected clock
only a current programme offers the watch action
a future programme that starts gains the action without taking the focus
a mere status change of the same source keeps the sheet
the action is read again at the end, so a sheet left open cannot play
the focus stays on the action while the programme is current
a focus already on Fermer is never moved
